'''Tammala''' was a fish spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who lulled fishers to sleep and ate their bait. "Tammala" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Tammala|the Ewok hermit]].<ref name="RESB">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tammala was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
